content.text:
Resubmitted with both repairs.

**Repairs made**
1. **Confidentiality carve-out made self-identifying:** "its breach of Paragraph 31" → "its breach of its confidentiality obligations under Paragraph 31". Verified against p0270, which is headed "31. CONFIDENTIALITY", so the cross-reference and the descriptor agree.
2. **Contradiction removed:** the unqualified "which are not subject to any limit" is replaced by "none of which is subject to the limit set out in this Subparagraph 21.3", plus a closing sentence confirming that nothing in 21.3 prejudices the Schedule B share limitation in 21.2. The Customer-favourable share ceiling and the several-not-joint rule therefore survive intact.
3. **Comment updated** to record that the Schedule B share limit is unaffected.

**Unchanged:** fallback target level, single insertion after §21.2, no survival tail, expense language, procedures or extra damages categories; preferred-level shortfalls (USD 1,000,000 floor, mutual consequential exclusion, data protection/security, fraud, IP and payment-obligation carve-outs) remain noted in the rationale only.
